transcript: These amazing life hacks will make your life easier. Sprinkle some baking soda on a lemon and scrub your tiles with it. They will look as good as new. Bananas usually ripen on one side when placed on a surface. Instead, roll a plastic bag into a circular shape and place it in the middle of the bananas. Now, hang them somewhere, this will ensure they ripen evenly. If your bag's zipper is broken, use a keyring as a handle. Attach it to the zipper and slide it open and close with ease. Cut a shampoo bottle into a specific shape and slightly heat it. the middle part. Use it as a storage holder in your bathroom for toothbrushes, razors, or soap. Before boiling potatoes, make a small cut around them. After boiling, the skin will peel off effortlessly. If you want to clean your fridge quickly and easily, use a hole punch to create perfectly shaped cleaning wipes or organizers. If your shower head is clogged and dirty, put it in a plastic bag filled with vinegar and seal the bag. After some time, take it out, it will shine like new.
